projects.title: AI 学习助手
projects.technologies: Go / Eino / ReAct / RAG / Milvus / 火山方舟
projects.description: 面向学习资料问答与编程辅助的个人项目，集多轮对话、知识库问答和工具调用于一体，通过 Go HTTP 服务提供 9 个 API。
details: 基于 Eino 串联中文递归分块、Ark Embedding 与 Milvus 索引检索，结合 Top-K 和余弦相似度阈值构建回答上下文，支持知识录入、持久化、检索及清空。
启动时探测实际向量维度，校验集合字段与模型标识；使用强一致性读写，支持新增、删除后的即时检索及数量查询。
使用 Eino ReAct 编排模型决策、工具执行与结果回传，接入计算器、时间等 4 类工具，设置 10 步执行上限。天气及搜索工具使用示例数据。

projects.title: 轻量写作与内容管理平台（ContentHub）
projects.technologies: Go / Gin / GORM / MySQL / Redis / JWT
projects.description: 面向个人写作与内容管理的个人项目，实现前后端一体化 Web 应用，覆盖用户注册登录和文章发布、浏览、编辑与删除。
details: 基于 Gin 构建 9 个 RESTful API，通过认证中间件校验身份，并在文章更新与删除时校验作者归属。
采用 JWT 双令牌与 Redis 保存会话和 JTI，通过 WATCH 事务原子轮换刷新令牌，退出时撤销会话，实现刷新令牌单次使用；使用 bcrypt 存储密码哈希。
使用 GORM 建模用户与文章的一对多关系，配合唯一索引、自动迁移及关联查询实现持久化；前端支持令牌自动换发、请求重试、文章管理与搜索。

projects.title: AI Learning Assistant
projects.technologies: Go / Eino / ReAct / RAG / Milvus / Volcengine Ark
projects.description: A personal web application for questions about learning materials and programming assistance. It combines multi-turn conversations, knowledge-base Q&A, and tool calling, with 9 APIs served over Go HTTP.
details: Built a knowledge-base pipeline with Eino, recursive Chinese text chunking, Ark Embedding, and Milvus. Top-K retrieval and cosine similarity thresholds select answer context, with support for ingestion, persistence, retrieval, and clearing the knowledge base.

Detects actual embedding dimensions at startup and checks collection fields and model identifiers. Strongly consistent reads and writes support immediate retrieval and count queries after additions or deletions.

Uses Eino ReAct to coordinate model decisions, tool execution, and result aggregation across four tool types, including calculation and time queries, with a 10-step execution limit. Weather and search tools use sample data.

projects.title: ContentHub — Lightweight Writing and Content Management
projects.technologies: Go / Gin / GORM / MySQL / Redis / JWT
projects.description: A personal full-stack web application for writing and content management, covering account registration and sign-in, plus article publishing, browsing, editing, and deletion.
details: Built 9 RESTful APIs with Gin. Authentication middleware checks user identity, while update and delete operations additionally verify article ownership.

Uses JWT access and refresh tokens, Redis sessions and JTIs, and WATCH transactions for atomic refresh-token rotation. Refresh tokens are single-use, sessions are revoked on sign-out, and passwords are hashed with bcrypt.

Models the one-to-many relationship between users and articles with GORM, unique indexes, automatic migrations, and association queries. The frontend supports automatic token refresh, request retries, article management, and search.
